gloss: number of cases; count (of incidents, orders)

definitions.gloss: number of cases; number of items; count
definitions.explanation: The count of discrete instances of something — incidents, orders, accidents, complaints, dispatches, etc. Used when {件|けん} (case, matter) is the natural counter for the things being counted, especially in statistics and business reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{件数|けんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{注文件数|ちゅうもんけんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked this month's order count.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出動件数|しゅつどうけんすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The number of ambulance dispatches is increasing year by year.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧ (case, matter) + ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number). Commonly attaches to nouns to form statistical terms like {注文件数|ちゅうもんけんすう} (order count) and ⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧{件数|けんすう} (number of inquiries).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {件数|けんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧ / ⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧: the number of cases increases / decreases
- {件数|けんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集計|しゅうけい}→集計：14598_shuukei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tally the number of cases
- ⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧{件数|けんすう}: number of inquiries
- {相談件数|そうだんけんすう}: number of consultations
- {出動件数|しゅつどうけんすう}: number of dispatches

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧: number of times — for repeated events ({利用回数|りようかいすう} 'number of uses')
- ⟦{数量|すうりょう}→数量：05473_suuryou⟧: quantity — for amounts of physical goods or stock
- ⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧: number of people
